  order_id STRING,
  event_time TIMESTAMP(3),
  event_type STRING,
  price DECIMAL(10, 2)
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'orders',

  'scan.startup.mode' = 'latest-offset',
  'connector.topic.partitioner' = 'round-robin'
);

  order_id STRING,
  event_time TIMESTAMP(3),
  event_type STRING,
  price DECIMAL(10, 2)
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'orders-validated',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'kafka:9092',
  'format' = 'json',
  'sink.partitioner' = 'round-robin'
);

# Set the parallelism of the Flink job
parallelism: 3

# Set the checkpointing interval
execution.checkpointing.interval: 500ms

# Set the Flink job name
job-name: session-event-enrichment

# Justification: 3 parallelism is chosen to match the number of TaskManagers. Checkpointing is enabled to ensure at-least-once delivery. The checkpointing interval is set to 500ms to ensure that the end-to-end latency is below 1s at p99.

CREATE TABLE session_events (
  user_id STRING,
  event JSON
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'session-events',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'kafka:9092',
  'format' = 'json',
  'scan.startup.mode' = 'latest-offset'
);

  user_id STRING,

) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'session-events-enriched',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'kafka:9092',

CREATE TABLE clicks (
  event_id STRING,
  event_time TIMESTAMP(3),
  event_data BYTES
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'clicks',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'kafka:9092',

  'scan.startup.mode' = 'latest-offset',
  'format.json.fail-on-missing-field' = 'false',
  'format.json.ignore-parse-errors' = 'true'
);

CREATE TABLE clicks_unique (
  event_id STRING,
  event_time TIMESTAMP(3),
  event_data BYTES
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'clicks-unique',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'kafka:9092',
  'format' = 'json',
  'sink.partitioner' = 'round-robin',
  'sink.delivery.guarantee' = 'exactly-once',
  'sink.transactional.id.prefix' = 'clicks-unique'
);

INSERT INTO clicks_unique
SELECT event_id, event_time, event_data
FROM clicks
GROUP BY event_id, event_time, event_data
HAVING event_time > FLOOR(event_time - INTERVAL '24' HOUR)
DISTRIBUTE BY event_id
PARTITIONED BY (event_id)
WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'clicks-unique',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'kafka:9092',
  'format' = 'json',
  'sink.partitioner' = 'round-robin',
  'sink.delivery.guarantee' = 'exactly-once',
  'sink.transactional.id.prefix' = 'clicks-unique'
);

  'format.type' = 'json'
);

FROM session_activity
GROUP BY session_id, state
HAVING last_update_time > current_timestamp - INTERVAL 30 DAY

# Flink SQL statements
CREATE TABLE ledger_entries (
    account_id STRING,
    amount DECIMAL(19, 4),
    event_time TIMESTAMP(3),
    WATERMARK FOR event_time AS event_time - INTERVAL '5' SECOND
) WITH (
    'connector' = 'kafka',
    'topic' = 'ledger-entries',
    'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'kafka:9092',
    'format' = 'json',
    'scan.startup.mode' = 'latest-offset',
    'connector.topic.partitioner' = 'round-robin'
);

CREATE TABLE balances (
    account_id STRING,
    balance DECIMAL(19, 4),
    event_time AS TO_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'))),
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id) NOT ENFORCED
) WITH (
    'connector' = 'upsert-kafka',
    'topic' = 'balances',
    'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'kafka:9092',
    'format' = 'json',
    'key.format' = 'json',
    'value.format' = 'json',
    'partitioner' = 'round-robin',
    'sink.checkpointing.enabled' = 'true',
    'sink.checkpointing.min-pending-checkpoints-to-keep' = '5',
    'sink.checkpointing.min-pending-checkpoints-to-retain' = '5',
    'sink.checkpointing.state-backend' = 'filesystem',
    'sink.checkpointing.state-backend.fs.checkpointdir' = 's3://flink-state/checkpoints'
);

INSERT INTO balances
SELECT
    account_id,
    SUM(amount) AS balance
FROM ledger_entries
GROUP BY account_id, event_time;
